purpose: Paste-ready t2v/i2v recipes for photographed moments — not glossy AI cards. Every recipe MUST have tool + prompt + aspect + duration + camera (lint fails if empty).

recipes.prompt: Documentary vertical phone video, 9:16. A real smartphone face-up on a scratched wood desk at night, warm practical lamp bokeh in the background, slight clutter (keys, paper invoice). Phone screen shows an incoming call UI (no brand logo). Shot on iPhone, imperfect framing, subtle handheld micro-shake, lamp flicker. Photographed moment — not a stock montage. No neon, no floating UI, no text redraw.
recipes.still_prompt: Documentary photo of a real smartphone face-up on a scratched wood desk at night, warm practical lamp in background bokeh, slight clutter (keys, invoice paper), phone screen showing incoming call UI, shot on iPhone, imperfect framing, no logo text burned in, no neon
recipes.i2v_prompt: subtle handheld drift, phone screen stays sharp, lamp flicker micro, no new objects, no typography redraw
recipes.ceiling_if_no_asset: handoff gen-pack first; assembler_stills_plus_sfx only if user declared no gen tools

recipes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 phone video of a real HVAC work van parked at a suburban bay door in daylight. Grease stains OK, honest dirt, no invented brand logos. Slight wide phone angle, gentle handheld, soft cloud drift. Optional person mid-ground walking toward the bay. Local-service truth — not cinematic drone, not stock smiling tech.
recipes.still_prompt: Real HVAC work van parked at suburban bay door, daylight, grease stains OK, no brand logos invented, phone photo, slight wide angle, honest dirt, person optional mid-ground walking
recipes.i2v_prompt: gentle handheld, clouds drift, no logo morph
recipes.ceiling_if_no_asset: handoff gen-pack; stock_or_user_shoot only after user declared no gen tools

recipes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 close-up phone video of real tradesperson hands with a wrench on an HVAC outdoor unit. Dirty knuckles, daylight from the open bay, shallow depth of field. Micro hand motion tightening a bolt; tool stays sharp. No face required, no logos, no neon grade. Proof-of-work moment.
recipes.still_prompt: Close-up real tradesperson hands with wrench on HVAC unit, dirty knuckles, daylight from bay, shallow depth, phone photo, no face required, no logo
recipes.i2v_prompt: micro hand motion tightening bolt, keep tool sharp
